title: Hunts FH-032S: Plug live partner state and the finale broadcast into route health

source.ref: Split from FH-032 (2026-11-16): route health shipped over the tables on main; FH-029 and FH-031 were being built in parallel and are not read yet.

detail: Route health (lib/hunts/route-health.ts) decides which Spaces are venues in one function, activeVenues, from the hunt_partners rows with the authz liveness rule, and reports the Hunt outbox as its message status. Owed by an agent once FH-029 and FH-031 are on main: read the live partner state from lib/hunts/partners.ts in activeVenues (pinned terms, the named steward, a withdrawn venue keeps its historic counts and drops from the active list), and add the finale broadcast state from lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts beside the outbox counts on /hunts/<slug>/health. Also link the two pages (/hunts/<slug>/health for organisers, /hunts/<slug>/report for venue staff) from the Trail's manage screen. Done when: a venue withdrawn through the partner flow leaves the organiser's active venue list on the next read while its past counts still reconcile, and the organiser sees whether the finale broadcast went out. Requires: FH-029, FH-031, FH-032. Owner role: Operations and analytics.
